rights: allowlisted streamer logs in and sees /api/me
rights: admin routes are admin-only
rights: switched-off feature is feature-off
rights: removed from the allowlist is not-allowed
rights: admin reads and saves access, invalid input is rejected
rights: admin lists the streamers
overlay: status, settings and commands are public
overlay: scenes are served as HTML, unknown logins and scenes are 404
events: without or with a wrong key 403
events: with the key the stream delivers a test alert
events: the log needs the session of the same streamer
events: unknown alert kind is 400
settings: read with the list of themes
settings: invalid values come back as codes per field
settings: valid values are saved and public
commands: help command is read and saved, broken input is 400
triggers: invalid rules are rejected with messages, the file stays
triggers: valid rules are saved, listed and fire
media: upload, list and public delivery
media: invalid names and uploads over the limit are rejected
media: a second upload while one runs is 409
media: delete, deleting again is 404
spotify: callback only connects with the state of a started login
spotify: logout disconnects
render: unknown clip and switched-off feature
overlay key: a new key replaces the old one
twitch: disconnect revokes the token, ends the runtime and the session
